candidate.name: taxonium
candidate.notes: DEMO ONLY, GPL-3.0, not for shipping. React 19, WebGL (deck.gl 9.1.14 bundled), singleton worker. Camera, colours and settings are reached through React fiber props of the library's inner Deck component.

tipClick.how: onNodeSelect(node_id) then onNodeDetailsLoaded(node_id, details); details.name is the tip label. The event reaches us only after the worker answered the details request (about 50 ms debounce plus a round trip)

internalNodeClick.how: Internal nodes have no marker: a click on the node's branch line selects it (pickingRadius 10 px). Same callbacks as tips; the node name comes back as n<preorder> because the adapter named the internal nodes in the Newick it wrote. The root has no edge and cannot be selected

branchClick.how: A branch click IS the node selection (the line object is the child node); the library cannot tell the two apart, so it is reported as nodeClick

hover.how: No hover prop or callback in 2.1.24. The library shows its own hover tooltip and ring internally (useHoverDetails), which we cannot subscribe to

descendantTipsInPayload.how: Details carry num_tips, not the tip list (the side panel has a separate "list" request that no callback exposes). Tip sets are computed from the TreeModel (source adapter-derived); num_tips is cross-checked in libraryPayload

cladeColouring.how: Colours TIP DOTS only (branches use one line colour from settings; internal nodes have no dots unless the internal-markers option is on). Done by giving every tip a unique key (TSV column) and pushing a key-to-RGB map into the library's own colour state through setAdditionalColorMapping (React fiber props of the inner Deck). O(tips) per change; the library recolours without a reload

highlightTip.how: query.srch / query.enabled (controlled prop): a text_per_line search on the tip name draws red rings (fixed colour list, radius 5 px). Debounced 500 ms plus a worker round trip; matching is case-insensitive; at most 10k results

focusTip.how: No prop. Calls the library's own view.setViewState (React fiber props of the inner Deck) with a new zoom and target; instant, no animation. query.zoomToSearch exists but is read only when the component mounts (useState initialiser), so it cannot refocus a loaded tree

tipAsLink.how: DOM overlay: real a[href][data-tip-id] elements for rows at least 8 px tall (the WebGL labels stay under them); other tips have no anchor

customColumns.how: No aligned per-tip columns. Metadata TSV columns only appear in the hover tooltip, the side panel and as a colour-by field

alignmentColumn.how: No alignment column (the JBrowse panel is for mutation-annotated trees of the Treenome kind, not for sequences from a FASTA)

radialLayout.how: Rectangular only: the layers are horizontal and vertical lines on an orthographic view (useLayers.tsx)

branchLengthToggle.how: The library always lays out with branch lengths (useDistances is forced true in the worker). A cladogram is obtained by writing the Newick without lengths and remounting the component (full reload of the tree). x_time exists only for jsonl/Nextstrain files, so xType cannot switch a Newick tree

scaleBar.how: No scale bar or time axis in the main view for a Newick tree (no axis layer in useLayers.tsx)

darkTheme.how: Host background via CSS; line, label and dot colours by the library settings setters (React fiber props). The library's own chrome (buttons, tooltips, hover ring, selection ring, minimap) is fixed light/black and does not follow

cssTokens.how: Background, line colour, tip colour and label colour from the GBIF tokens through settings setters and the colour mapping. Not possible: label font (hard-coded Roboto in the TextLayer), highlight colour, selection ring, tooltip chrome, minimap colours

multipleInstances.how: useLocalBackend.ts creates ONE module-level Worker and global onQueryReceipt/onConfigReceipt callbacks: a second <Taxonium> replaces the first one's tree (see S13)

cleanUnmount.how: React unmount tears down deck.gl, but the module-level worker is never terminated and keeps the last parsed tree in memory (see S13 and the leak probe)

controlledState.how: query/updateQuery control search, colour field and x axis. Selection, camera and colour mapping are internal state (reached through fiber props)

zoomToFit.how: The library's default view is a fixed zoom/target, not a fit; the adapter fits on mount through view.setViewState. The in-canvas reset button returns to the library default, not to our fit

overviewOrMinimap.how: Built-in minimap (top right) showing the whole de-overplotted tree and the viewport; click to pan. Toggle in Library options (settings.toggleMinimapEnabled)

caveat: Headless Chromium without a GPU (SwiftShader software rendering): absolute FPS for canvas and WebGL candidates is pessimistic; use for functional tests and relative comparison. Final scale numbers need a real browser on a normal laptop.

thresholds.note: unusable = load > 10 s, or > 50% of the time in frames > 50 ms (best of 3 rounds), or > 100 ms main-thread CPU per interaction step, or click latency > 300 ms; p5 FPS is reported (best of 3) but not judged

load.note: os.loadavg()[0] (1-minute); runs with start or end load above 4 are marked noisy
